findings.description: Linear issue lookup ran once per eligible finding after removing the unsupported server-side description filter.
findings.failure_scenario: A run with 49 human-routed findings would download the same project issue list 49 times sequentially, slowing delivery and risking provider rate limits.

findings.description: A single first-page Linear lookup could miss an existing fingerprint marker.
findings.failure_scenario: When the configured Linear project has more than 250 issues and the matching issue is on a later page, the agent creates a duplicate issue.

findings.description: A malformed first structured result failed during materialization without activating the second Sentry attempt.
findings.failure_scenario: Claude reports action success but returns an unparseable or wrong-shaped object; materialization fails, the retry condition ignores it, and Sentry triage ends without the promised retry.

findings.description: Linear pagination trusted a repeated nonempty end cursor.
findings.failure_scenario: A malformed provider response reports `hasNextPage: true` with the same cursor repeatedly, causing the health-agent delivery job to loop until timeout.

findings.description: Slack failure summaries ignored the orchestrator's `failure` field.
findings.failure_scenario: A collector or Linear failure represented as `{ failure: ... }` appears as `Unspecified failure`, making the summary non-actionable.

findings.description: Passing the existing numeric App ID secret through the action's `client-id` input might appear semantically mismatched.
findings.failure_scenario: If the action treated client ID differently from App ID, token generation would fail in publish and cleanup jobs.
